detail.longDescription: """ Software development is iterative, yet agentic coding benchmarks hide design issues through their single-shot setup. (...) We introduce SlopCodeBench, a benchmark of 36 problems and 196 checkpoints where agents repeatedly extend their own solutions. (...) Compared to 473 open-source Python repositories, agent code is 2.3x more verbose and 2.0x more eroded, and the human repositories degrade less often and by smaller margins across their git histories. Explicit quality guidance reduces initial verbosity and erosion by up to a third, without affecting degradation rates. """ https:// arxiv.org/abs/2603.24755 # ai # programming
